title: arabis nuttallii
intro: Arabis nuttallii, commonly known as Nuttall's rockcress, is a perennial plant species in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It is native to the western United States and has been used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Arabis nuttallii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Arabis nuttallii include glucosinolates, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
